name: Energy Drink Freak
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve spiky blond man, black/chartreuse shirt, gray shorts and chunky trainers. Chartreuse should retain high red/green with low blue; inspect keying and avoid cyan liquid. Review can count, main burst, title and native audio.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 8-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Energy Drink Freak — Fourth Can, No Plan.
IDENTITY: the exact wild-eyed pale adult man with spiky blond hair, dark under-eye shadows, black-and-chartreuse lightning-patterned shirt, gray knee-length shorts, white socks and chunky black/white/chartreuse sneakers. Keep his black-and-yellow-green drink can design abstract, without invented product names or logos. Original comic character, no costume transformation.
0–1.2s: establish his complete body. Three visibly empty crushed cans hover loosely behind him. He shakes a fourth unopened can with a recklessly delighted grin; its metal sides bulge and chatter under ridiculous pressure.
1.2–3.2s: extreme close-up of the pull-tab snapping open, followed immediately by a violent camera pullback. A HUGE opaque lemon-yellow and cream carbonation jet erupts like a cannon. He wrestles the ordinary-sized can with both hands while the jet becomes a thirty-foot corkscrew of thick illustrated liquid and dense bubbles. The recoil sends his entire body flying backward, legs pedaling wildly. Keep liquid warm yellow with strong black contour lines, not translucent cyan mist; leave pure cyan surrounding all effects.
3.2–4.8s: he finally swings the jet toward the three empty cans, which spin into a vertical stack far in front of him. One enormous concentrated pressure shot PUNCHES straight through the stack, crushing all three into a single silver-black puck with a huge yellow-orange impact star. Camera tracks the projectile into depth, hits a readable contact freeze, then snaps back through the dissipating jet. One dominant cannon BOOM with rattling metallic crush; no ground, scenery or fullscreen flash.
4.8–6s: the jet shuts off, and he snaps back to a full-body, knees-bent heroic pose with his shirt and hair blown backward. Exact title FOURTH CAN, NO PLAN slams in three bold stable comic lines under his face.
6–8s: he tries to raise one triumphant fist but it trembles comically; the tiny discarded pull-tab finally lands on his head with a ping. He looks up cross-eyed, still grinning, then holds the exhausted overcharged pose. Do not introduce another drink. SFX: rapid metal rattle, pull-tab crack, colossal pressurized jet, accelerated air rush, crushing cannon impact, fizzy shutdown and tiny final ping. No speech, music or familiar franchise sounds.
